title: Medical Robotics and Devices Lab Data Repository — da Vinci tool input/output characterization
institution: University of Minnesota Medical Robotics and Devices Lab
evidence_level: measured files; all numeric trial logs

rights.source_attribution: Contains information from the University of Minnesota Medical Robotics and Devices Lab MRDLab/mis-tool-characterization database, made available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
rights.visualization_code: Author repository assigns GPL-3.0 to visualization code. The independent NumPy calculation here does not redistribute that code.
rights.derivative_tables: mrd-bench-runs.csv and mrd-command-excursions.csv are provided under ODbL 1.0. See source_attribution, database and contents. The repository contains numerical summaries; fetch the original time series from the author repository.

acquisition.inventory_rule: All case-insensitive data/<folder>/<digits>.txt entries in the fixed recursive tree. Serial logs, readmes, trained weights and software are outside the trial table. Each file byte count and Git blob SHA-1 was recomputed before parsing.

signal_constraints: Proximal (back) and distal (front) reactions are measured with separate Futek TFF325 devices on the same synchronized sampling system. SHA-verified files supply native signs. Torque scaling is 0.000039811 N·m per count. No filtering or zero-offset correction was applied. Use file ranges for within-trial descriptive comparisons; right-jaw signs are not standardized across tools.

Column 8 is the back-end command recorded by the authors, described as an analog output in [-1,1]. Column 4 is back-end measured current. Column 7 is the front-end load command: README says ampere, but multiple individual headers and conversion code question that unit, so the tables retain native units. The two command columns belong to different motors; their difference is not clipping.

Column 1 is labeled ms, whereas the published 1 kHz timing and the median observed 0.001 increment per trial are consistent with a time field in seconds. The table keeps native clock values. The two command decimals/precision differ across files.

No separate, physically sampled analog connector output, post-limiter back-end command, saturation bit or actual ADC/DAC range was identified in these 10 columns. Exact equality and out-of-range counts are for logged field values only.

result.interpretation: A run holds front native command 0.8 while the back command exceeds 1 for 18 samples, with measured current and two changing reaction torques on the same acquisition clock. Three remaining negative out-of-range samples are at indices 1/2 of two right-jaw files. Insufficient evidence to reconstruct a software limit or establish a physical current/supply limit. Front-end load command is constant within each of all 340 runs.

reproduce: python derive_mrd.py OUTPUT_DIRECTORY CACHE_DIRECTORY; requires NumPy. All 340 original files were downloaded and the script was executed on 2026-11-21 UTC.
